N. of a king of Madra and brother of Mādrī, the second wife of Pāṇḍu,
 and thus maternal uncle of Nakula and Sahadeva. (In the great war he at
 first intended to fight on the side of the Pāṇdavas, but he was
 artfully won over by Duryodhana and subsequently fought in his behalf.
 He acted as charioteer to Karṇa when he was generalissimo of the Kaurava
 forces, and after his
[]
 death was appointed commander. He maintained the field for one day, but
 was at last slain by Yudhiṣṭhira).
